units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Kua-Oa-Aava|You watch for a couple of minutes as the spaceport crew here attempt to find a fuel adapter that fits your ship. After some time, a group of military officers is called over; they scan the side of the <ship> thoroughly and input their results into a datapad. Eventually the leader produces another one of the Successors' morphic metal spheres; they briefly connect it to the datapad and it rapidly squishes into a shape that lets it interface with both your ship and the fuel hose.|23|0
units.english: You watch for a couple of minutes as the spaceport crew here attempt to find a fuel adapter that fits your ship. After some time, a group of military officers is called over; they scan the side of the <ship> thoroughly and input their results into a datapad. Eventually the leader produces another one of the Successors' morphic metal spheres; they briefly connect it to the datapad and it rapidly squishes into a shape that lets it interface with both your ship and the fuel hose.
units.italian: Osservate per un paio di minuti mentre il personale dello spazioporto qui cerca un adattatore per il carburante adatto alla vostra nave. Dopo un po' vengono chiamati alcuni ufficiali militari; esaminano a fondo il fianco della <ship> e inseriscono i risultati in un datapad. Alla fine il capo tira fuori un'altra delle sfere di metallo morfico dei Successori; la collega brevemente al datapad e quella si schiaccia rapidamente in una forma che le permette di interfacciarsi sia con la vostra nave sia con la manichetta del carburante.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|One of the Successors in the spaceport here seems to be offering small morsels of food to the others; short cooked strips of a dark green plant vaguely resembling a succulent, impaled on a wooden stick. Though most of the individuals here keep their distance from you, this one takes notice and offers you a stick.|34|0
units.english: One of the Successors in the spaceport here seems to be offering small morsels of food to the others; short cooked strips of a dark green plant vaguely resembling a succulent, impaled on a wooden stick. Though most of the individuals here keep their distance from you, this one takes notice and offers you a stick.
units.italian: Uno dei Successori nello spazioporto qui sembra offrire piccoli bocconi di cibo agli altri: brevi strisce cotte di una pianta verde scuro che ricorda vagamente una succulenta, infilzate su uno stecco di legno. Benché quasi tutti qui vi tengano a distanza, questo individuo se ne accorge e vi offre uno stecco.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	(Take it.)|36|0
units.english: (Take it.)
units.italian: (Prendilo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	(Decline.)|37|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	You take the stick from them and a wave of color runs up their body before they slither away to a different part of the spaceport.|39|0
units.english: You take the stick from them and a wave of color runs up their body before they slither away to a different part of the spaceport.
units.italian: Prendete lo stecco e un'onda di colore gli risale lungo il corpo, poi scivola via verso un'altra parte dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	(Try a bite.)|41|0
units.english: (Try a bite.)
units.italian: (Assaggiane un pezzo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	(Hide it away.)|42|0
units.english: (Hide it away.)
units.italian: (Nascondilo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	Though you only take a small bite, the food tastes vile enough for you to gag: it is tough and fishy and far too salty for your palate. You discreetly spit out what little you consumed and consider yourself lucky that you didn't have to pay anything for it.|44|0
units.english: Though you only take a small bite, the food tastes vile enough for you to gag: it is tough and fishy and far too salty for your palate. You discreetly spit out what little you consumed and consider yourself lucky that you didn't have to pay anything for it.
units.italian: Anche se ne prendete solo un pezzetto, il cibo ha un sapore così disgustoso da farvi venire i conati: è duro, sa di pesce ed è troppo salato per il vostro palato. Sputate con discrezione quel poco che avete inghiottito e vi considerate fortunati a non aver dovuto pagare nulla.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	After a couple of seconds the Successor retracts their arm and slithers off to a different part of the spaceport.|47|0
units.english: After a couple of seconds the Successor retracts their arm and slithers off to a different part of the spaceport.
units.italian: Dopo un paio di secondi il Successore ritrae il braccio e scivola via verso un'altra parte dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit|	You hold the stick behind your back until you head back inside the <ship> and place it in a waste receptacle.|50|0
units.english: You hold the stick behind your back until you head back inside the <ship> and place it in a waste receptacle.
units.italian: Tenete lo stecco dietro la schiena finché non rientrate nella <ship> e lo mettete in un cestino dei rifiuti.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Iyra-Ijasa-Iret|You've never seen a spaceport that's entirely underwater before. Next to your landing pad, there's a massive window into what you might call an aquarium but what seems to be some sort of lounge for the Successors, who swim around and organize themselves around several multi-layered tables.|61|0
units.english: You've never seen a spaceport that's entirely underwater before. Next to your landing pad, there's a massive window into what you might call an aquarium but what seems to be some sort of lounge for the Successors, who swim around and organize themselves around several multi-layered tables.
units.italian: Non avevate mai visto uno spazioporto completamente sott'acqua. Accanto alla piazzola di atterraggio c'è una grande vetrata su quello che potreste chiamare acquario ma che sembra una specie di salotto per i Successori, che nuotano e si dispongono intorno a diversi tavoli a più livelli.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mavra-Sol-Kvel|Your ship draws a bit of a crowd when you land here, though most are kept at bay by a set of pre-arranged barriers set up around your landing pad and the occasional patrolling guard. While walking by the barrier, one Successor offers one of their data-spheres to you.|72|0
units.english: Your ship draws a bit of a crowd when you land here, though most are kept at bay by a set of pre-arranged barriers set up around your landing pad and the occasional patrolling guard. While walking by the barrier, one Successor offers one of their data-spheres to you.
units.italian: La vostra nave richiama una piccola folla quando atterrate qui, anche se ai più tengono testa delle barriere predisposte intorno alla piazzola e qualche guardia di pattuglia. Passando accanto alla barriera, un Successore vi offre una delle sue sfere di dati.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mavra-Sol-Kvel|	(Take it.)|74|0
units.english: (Take it.)
units.italian: (Prendila.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mavra-Sol-Kvel|	(Refuse.)|76|0
units.english: (Refuse.)
units.italian: (Non accettare.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mavra-Sol-Kvel|	The Successor trills warmly when you take the sphere, though they are quickly pushed back by one of the guards. Like previously, the sphere expands into a small star map as soon as you touch it, though this one seems to contain some cultural data in addition to stellar coordinates.|81|0
units.english: The Successor trills warmly when you take the sphere, though they are quickly pushed back by one of the guards. Like previously, the sphere expands into a small star map as soon as you touch it, though this one seems to contain some cultural data in addition to stellar coordinates.
units.italian: Il Successore trilla con calore quando prendete la sfera, ma viene subito respinto da una delle guardie. Come prima, la sfera si espande in una piccola mappa stellare appena la toccate, anche se questa sembra contenere dati culturali oltre alle coordinate stellari.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mavra-Sol-Kvel|	You hold up your hands and step away from the individual offering you the data-sphere, and they are quickly pushed back by one of the guards.|84|0
units.english: You hold up your hands and step away from the individual offering you the data-sphere, and they are quickly pushed back by one of the guards.
units.italian: Alzate le mani e vi allontanate dall'individuo che vi offre la sfera di dati; viene subito respinto da una delle guardie.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact Exploration: Mosaa-Oa-Vyret|Near to your landing pad in the spaceport here, you see a large circular pool with several Successors milling about in it. Some relax against the edges while others appear deep in conversation; one trio of individuals is followed by a small salamander-like animal that swims behind them and plays between and around their arms, making soft splashing noises as it jumps in and out of the water.|100|0
units.english: Near to your landing pad in the spaceport here, you see a large circular pool with several Successors milling about in it. Some relax against the edges while others appear deep in conversation; one trio of individuals is followed by a small salamander-like animal that swims behind them and plays between and around their arms, making soft splashing noises as it jumps in and out of the water.
units.italian: Vicino alla piazzola di atterraggio dello spazioporto vedete una grande vasca circolare con diversi Successori che si aggirano dentro. Alcuni si rilassano contro i bordi, altri sembrano immersi in una conversazione; un terzetto è seguito da un piccolo animale simile a una salamandra che nuota dietro di loro e gioca fra e intorno alle loro braccia, con leggeri tonfi d'acqua mentre salta dentro e fuori dalla vasca.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|While waiting in the spaceport for the <ship> to be refueled, you notice that a small crowd of Successors is gathering around one of the pools of water that surround the starship hangars. Many are moving excitedly towards the commotion or, having already made it there, undulate strangely in the water.|113|0
units.english: While waiting in the spaceport for the <ship> to be refueled, you notice that a small crowd of Successors is gathering around one of the pools of water that surround the starship hangars. Many are moving excitedly towards the commotion or, having already made it there, undulate strangely in the water.
units.italian: Mentre aspettate allo spazioporto che la <ship> faccia rifornimento, notate che una piccola folla di Successori si raduna intorno a una delle vasche d'acqua che circondano gli hangar delle navi. Molti si muovono eccitati verso il trambusto o, già arrivati, ondulano stranamente nell'acqua.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Investigate the gathering.)|115|0
units.english: (Investigate the gathering.)
units.italian: (Vai a vedere l'adunata.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Ignore it.)|116|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignora.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	You walk over the water-covered floor to the group, and as you start to grow closer, you begin to hear music coming from the pool: a strange, lilting melody, which is filled with notes that seem impossibly high or low or both at once. As you squeeze your way through the crowd, you see that in the pool there is a trio of submerged Successors, each of whom has their arms wrapped around one or several wildly distinct metal devices which protrude through the surface of the water. It is from these devices that the music emanates.|118|0
units.english: You walk over the water-covered floor to the group, and as you start to grow closer, you begin to hear music coming from the pool: a strange, lilting melody, which is filled with notes that seem impossibly high or low or both at once. As you squeeze your way through the crowd, you see that in the pool there is a trio of submerged Successors, each of whom has their arms wrapped around one or several wildly distinct metal devices which protrude through the surface of the water. It is from these devices that the music emanates.
units.italian: Attraversate il pavimento coperto d'acqua verso il gruppo e, avvicinandovi, cominciate a sentire musica venire dalla vasca: una melodia strana e cadenzata, piena di note che sembrano impossibilmente alte o basse, o entrambe insieme. Vi fate largo fra la folla e vedete che nella vasca ci sono tre Successori sommersi, ciascuno con le braccia avvolte intorno a uno o più strumenti metallici molto diversi fra loro che sporgono dalla superficie dell'acqua. È da questi strumenti che viene la musica.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	One of the Successors in the pool begins to sing - at least, singing is the best way you could describe it; they press one of the longer and more cylindrical instruments up to their head and it begins producing an accompaniment to the other instruments' melody that your translation device occasionally recognizes as words:|119|0
units.english: One of the Successors in the pool begins to sing - at least, singing is the best way you could describe it; they press one of the longer and more cylindrical instruments up to their head and it begins producing an accompaniment to the other instruments' melody that your translation device occasionally recognizes as words:
units.italian: Uno dei Successori nella vasca comincia a cantare, o almeno cantare è il modo migliore per descriverlo; preme uno degli strumenti più lunghi e cilindrici contro la testa e questo comincia a produrre un accompagnamento alla melodia degli altri strumenti che il vostro dispositivo di traduzione ogni tanto riconosce come parole:

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	"... sweetest child... never want... not so... somber current... endure..."|120|0
units.english: "... sweetest child... never want... not so... somber current... endure..."
units.italian: "... dolcissimo figlio... mai volere... non così... corrente cupa... resistere..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	It is not clear whether or not this represents the entire lyric content of the performance or simply if the translation device is unable to parse the more tonal phrases. The submerged singer displays a variety of colors and textures on their skin, changing with each successive phrase; green and rough on a splittingly high note, pink and smooth-looking on a strangely growl-like low section. Several in the crowd emulate this in their own skin patterning; the group pulses in color and pattern in time with the melody of the music.|121|0
units.english: It is not clear whether or not this represents the entire lyric content of the performance or simply if the translation device is unable to parse the more tonal phrases. The submerged singer displays a variety of colors and textures on their skin, changing with each successive phrase; green and rough on a splittingly high note, pink and smooth-looking on a strangely growl-like low section. Several in the crowd emulate this in their own skin patterning; the group pulses in color and pattern in time with the melody of the music.
units.italian: Non è chiaro se questo rappresenti l'intero contenuto lirico dell'esecuzione o se semplicemente il dispositivo di traduzione non riesca a comprendere le frasi più tonali. Il cantante sommerso mostra una varietà di colori e texture sulla pelle, che cambiano a ogni frase successiva: verde e ruvida su una nota acutissima, rosa e dall'aspetto liscio su una sezione bassa stranamente simile a un ringhio. Diversi nella folla lo imitano con i propri disegni cutanei; il gruppo pulsa di colore e di disegno a tempo con la melodia della musica.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Continue listening.)|123|0
units.english: (Continue listening.)
units.italian: (Continua ad ascoltare.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Return to my ship.)|124|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	The music eventually crescendos with a long, droning wail of instrumentation accompanied by a rapid, high-pitched vocal performance that sees the water in the pool sloshing from side to side as the trio within move rapturously, circling around each other faster and faster before suddenly stopping. The performance comes to a close with a gentler and more playful section that sees the performers blowing bubbles to the surface of the pool and producing short, semi-random notes on their bizarre instruments.|126|0
units.english: The music eventually crescendos with a long, droning wail of instrumentation accompanied by a rapid, high-pitched vocal performance that sees the water in the pool sloshing from side to side as the trio within move rapturously, circling around each other faster and faster before suddenly stopping. The performance comes to a close with a gentler and more playful section that sees the performers blowing bubbles to the surface of the pool and producing short, semi-random notes on their bizarre instruments.
units.italian: Alla fine la musica cresce in un lungo lamento prolungato degli strumenti, accompagnato da un'esecuzione vocale rapida e acuta, e l'acqua della vasca ondeggia da un lato all'altro mentre il trio dentro si muove estatico, cerchiandosi sempre più velocemente prima di fermarsi di colpo. L'esecuzione si chiude con una sezione più dolce e giocosa, in cui gli esecutori soffiano bolle verso la superficie della vasca e producono note brevi e semi-casuali sui loro strani strumenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	The Successors around you produce a dull, low hum after the piece's conclusion.|127|0
units.english: The Successors around you produce a dull, low hum after the piece's conclusion.
units.italian: I Successori intorno a voi producono un cupo ronzio basso dopo la conclusione del pezzo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Applaud.)|129|0
units.english: (Applaud.)
units.italian: (Applaudi.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Try to hum myself.)|131|0
units.english: (Try to hum myself.)
units.italian: (Prova a ronzare anche io.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	(Return to my ship.)|133|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	The Successors around you seem a little surprised or perhaps confused by your display, but do not express any offense at it, as far as you can tell. The trio of performers eventually emerge from the pool, gently tucking their instruments into various equally oddly-shaped cases before chatting with some of the few remaining members of the crowd and then departing.|136|0
units.english: The Successors around you seem a little surprised or perhaps confused by your display, but do not express any offense at it, as far as you can tell. The trio of performers eventually emerge from the pool, gently tucking their instruments into various equally oddly-shaped cases before chatting with some of the few remaining members of the crowd and then departing.
units.italian: I Successori intorno a voi sembrano un po' sorpresi, o forse confusi, dalla vostra esibizione, ma non ne mostrano offesa, per quanto possiate capire. Il trio degli esecutori alla fine emerge dalla vasca, infila con delicatezza gli strumenti in altrettante custodie di forma bizzarra, scambia qualche parola con i pochi rimasti fra il pubblico e poi va via.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	The Successors around you seem amused by your attempt to emulate the humming; some briefly display a bluish-green wave of color across their skin before quickly returning to their base shade. Nonetheless, no one here seems to take any significant offense at the gesture. The performers eventually emerge from the pool, gently tucking their instruments into equally oddly-shaped cases before chatting with some of the few remaining members of the crowd and then departing.|139|0
units.english: The Successors around you seem amused by your attempt to emulate the humming; some briefly display a bluish-green wave of color across their skin before quickly returning to their base shade. Nonetheless, no one here seems to take any significant offense at the gesture. The performers eventually emerge from the pool, gently tucking their instruments into equally oddly-shaped cases before chatting with some of the few remaining members of the crowd and then departing.
units.italian: Ai Successori intorno a voi il vostro tentativo di imitare il ronzio sembra divertente; alcuni mostrano brevemente un'onda di colore blu-verde sulla pelle prima di tornare rapidamente alla loro tonalità di base. Nessuno qui sembra comunque offendersi seriamente per il gesto. Gli esecutori alla fine emergono dalla vasca, infilano con delicatezza gli strumenti in custodie altrettanto bizzarre, scambiano qualche parola con i pochi rimasti fra il pubblico e poi vanno via.

units.id: mission:Successors: Buskers|	You return to your ship, gently extricating yourself from the throng of spellbound Successors, who continue to shimmer and sway in the distance until the performance eventually ends and they disperse to go their separate ways.|142|0
units.english: You return to your ship, gently extricating yourself from the throng of spellbound Successors, who continue to shimmer and sway in the distance until the performance eventually ends and they disperse to go their separate ways.
units.italian: Tornate alla vostra nave, liberandovi con delicatezza dalla folla di Successori incantati, che continuano a brillare e ondeggiare in lontananza finché l'esecuzione non finisce e si disperdono, ognuno per la propria strada.
